# Spark & Stitch Institute

> > Brain science-based parenting education for raising connected, courageous children in the digital age.

Spark & Stitch Institute, founded by Erin Walsh and Dr. David Walsh, provides evidence-based parenting strategies rooted in adolescent brain science. The institute offers online courses, podcasts, blogs, and speaking engagements focused on digital wellness, emotional development, screen time management, and building resilience in children from pre-K through teens.

## Key Topics

- Adolescent brain development
- Digital wellness
- Screen time management
- Parenting education
- Child emotional development
- Resilience building
- Media literacy
- Tech safety
- Parent-child connection
- Courageous parenting
- Boundaries and discipline
- Online safety
- Teen development
- Early childhood development
- Parent wellness

## Core Learning Programs

- [Online Classes](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/learn/online-classes): Listing of self-paced online courses on digital wellness, teen parenting, and boundaries
- [CONNECTED Online Class - Enroll Now](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/connected-enroll-now): Enrollment page for CONNECTED course on digital wellbeing and child connection
- [Why Do They Act That Way Online Class - Enroll Now](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/wdtatw-enroll-now): Enrollment for teen parenting course based on bestselling adolescent brain book
- [Say Yes to No - Enroll Now](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/say-yes-to-no-enroll-now): Enrollment for self-paced course on setting loving boundaries with children
- [Walk Towards It - Online Class for Parents](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/creative-projects/walk-towards-it-online-class-for-parents): Poetry-based online class for parent wellness, reflection, and introspection

## Parenting Guidance by Age Group

- [Pre-K & Kids](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/for-parents/pre-k-kids): Parenting guidance for pre-K and early childhood emotional development
- [Teenagers](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/for-parents/parenting-teens): Teen parenting guide explaining adolescent brain science and developmental tips
- [Screen Time](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/for-parents/screen-time): Research-based guidance on screen time management and first device decisions
- [Connection & Courage](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/for-parents/connection-courage): Brain science resource for raising courageous kids with emotional development focus

- [Parenting Blog](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/learn/parenting-blog): Parenting blog with stories and science on raising connected, courageous kids

- [Free Resources](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/learn/free-resources): Free evidence-based guides and links for parenting and mental health challenges
- [Creative Projects](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/creative-projects): Creative projects including poetry and arts-based parenting education initiatives
- [Ask Us](https://sparkandstitchinstitute.com/ask-us): Contact form for community engagement and questions
